title: GitHub search results for GDScript Godot 4 migration issues
key_points: The search query is looking for issues related to the GDScript Godot 4 migration in the official Godot engine repository.
The results show a total of 61 issues that match the search criteria.

Some of the highlighted issues include audio syncing problems with VideoPlayer nodes, resource loading through GDScript preload() never being unloaded, and requests for soft access restriction for members prefixed with _.
limitations: The source only provides a snapshot of the current state of reported migration issues without additional context or analysis.
It is unclear how many of these issues have been resolved or are still open.
The search results do not give an overall picture of the progress and challenges in the GDScript Godot 4 migration.
asserts: There are currently 61 reported issues related to the GDScript Godot 4 migration in the official Godot engine repository on GitHub.
scope: This source provides a snapshot of the current state of reported migration issues for the GDScript Godot 4 update in the official Godot engine repository on GitHub, without additional context or analysis.
